must_have_fields: patient_id脱敏, encounter_id, icu_stay_id或可生成stay的字段, hospital_admit_time, hospital_discharge_time, icu_intime, icu_outtime, death_time或死亡标志
strongly_recommended_fields: sex, age或birth_date脱敏后年龄, first_careunit, admission_type, discharge_status
time_window_to_extract: 全住院 + ICU 入出科全程
why_needed: 生成研究对象、landmark12、window60、死亡结局和所有表的连接主键
derived_mimic_features_later: subject_id/hadm_id/stay_id, intime, landmark12_time, window60_time, age, sex, first ICU unit
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 没有 icu_stay_id 时，用 patient_id + encounter_id + icu_intime + icu_outtime 生成

one_row_represents: 一条诊断编码或诊断名称
must_have_fields: patient_id, encounter_id, diagnosis_code, diagnosis_name, diagnosis_sequence, diagnosis_type, icd_version或编码体系
time_window_to_extract: index 住院及既往可获得诊断
why_needed: 定义 AHF 队列、Charlson 合并症、感染来源/基础疾病
derived_mimic_features_later: HF ICD evidence, acute HF flag, Charlson components, infection source candidate
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 如果无 ICD 编码，至少导出诊断名称、诊断顺序和诊断类型

source_system: ICU 护理记录/监护系统
one_row_represents: 一次生命体征记录，或同一时间点多项生命体征
must_have_fields: patient_id或encounter_id或icu_stay_id, charttime, heart_rate, sbp, dbp, map或mbp, resp_rate, spo2, temperature
time_window_to_extract: ICU 入科前6小时到入科后12小时；至少 ICU 0-12h
why_needed: 当前模型核心变量，也是 080A 动态血流动力学负荷特征来源
derived_mimic_features_later: HR/SBP/MAP/RR/SpO2 first/last/min/max/mean/delta, MAP<65比例, shock index, modified shock index, pulse pressure, slopes
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 若无 MAP，可用 SBP/DBP 估算 MAP；若只有班次汇总，趋势和负荷会受限

must_have_fields: patient_id, encounter_id, sample_time或charttime, test_code, test_name, result_value, result_unit
time_window_to_extract: 住院入院前24小时到 ICU 入科后12小时；至少 ICU 0-12h
why_needed: 当前模型实验室特征与后续心衰/心肌损伤特征
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 如果不同检验系统分表，先按项目名统一成长表

must_have_fields: patient_id, encounter_id或icu_stay_id, sample_time, lactate, ph, bicarbonate或hco3, base_excess, po2, pco2
strongly_recommended_fields: specimen_type动脉/静脉, fio2, oxygen_device, result_unit
time_window_to_extract: 住院入院前24小时到 ICU 入科后12小时；至少 ICU 0-12h
why_needed: 当前模型已有乳酸/酸碱变量，后续要做乳酸清除率和酸碱趋势
derived_mimic_features_later: lactate first/last/min/max/mean/delta, lactate clearance, persistent lactate elevation, pH/HCO3/base excess trends
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 若无 specimen_type 也可先导出，但需在审计中标记

source_system: 用药执行/eMAR/输注泵/ICU 治疗系统
one_row_represents: 一次升压药或强心药实际执行/输注区间
must_have_fields: patient_id, encounter_id或icu_stay_id, drug_name, start_time, end_time, dose_or_rate, dose_unit, route
strongly_recommended_fields: patient_weight_kg_at_time, concentration, pump_rate, order_id, administration_status, stop_reason
time_window_to_extract: ICU 入科前6小时到入科后60小时；至少 ICU 0-60h
why_needed: 这是 pre12 shock 排除、0-12h 支持特征、12-60h 结局标签的关键表
derived_mimic_features_later: vasopressor/inotrope flags, agent count, NEE 0-12h, pre12 NEE max, post12 NEE delta, support escalation outcome
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 如果没有输注泵，优先实际给药执行记录；单纯医嘱只能做敏感性分析

one_row_represents: 一次袢利尿剂给药记录
must_have_fields: patient_id, encounter_id或icu_stay_id, drug_name, administration_time或start_time, dose, dose_unit, route
time_window_to_extract: 入院前24小时到 ICU 入科后12小时；后续可扩展到 0-60h
why_needed: AHF 证据、容量治疗反应和尿量/利尿剂反应
derived_mimic_features_later: iv_loop_rx_early12_flag, loop diuretic furosemide-equivalent dose, urine per diuretic response
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 若只有医嘱，标记为 order_only，不能等同实际执行

one_row_represents: 一次抗菌药给药或医嘱记录
must_have_fields: patient_id, encounter_id或icu_stay_id, antibiotic_name, start_time或administration_time, end_time, route, dose
time_window_to_extract: ICU 入科前24小时到入科后12小时
why_needed: 疑似感染和 early sepsis12 定义
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 实际执行优先；若只有医嘱，需同步培养时间佐证

one_row_represents: 一次培养送检或微生物结果
time_window_to_extract: ICU 入科前24小时到入科后60小时；至少 -24到12h 用于 sepsis
why_needed: 疑似感染定义、感染来源分类和院内数据审计
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 若无最终结果，至少要送检时间和标本部位

must_have_fields: patient_id, encounter_id或icu_stay_id, charttime或start_time/end_time, output_type, volume_ml
why_needed: 当前模型尿量变量，后续容量/利尿反应
derived_mimic_features_later: urineoutput_0_12h_total_ml, low urine output flag, urine/diuretic response
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 若只有班次总尿量，需要班次开始/结束时间用于分摊

source_system: ICU 入量/输液/输血/营养记录
must_have_fields: patient_id, encounter_id或icu_stay_id, start_time或charttime, end_time, input_type, amount_ml
why_needed: 后续容量状态、净平衡和治疗反应
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 若只有总入量，仍可做净平衡粗特征，但不能分液体类型

source_system: 呼吸机系统/ICU 护理/氧疗记录
one_row_represents: 一次呼吸支持状态或区间
why_needed: 当前模型呼吸支持变量和 SOFA 呼吸分组件
derived_mimic_features_later: invasive ventilation, noninvasive ventilation, HFNC, oxygen support flags, PF ratio support context
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 若只有某时点状态，需 charttime；无法精确区间时审计中标记

source_system: ICU 护理/神经系统评分
why_needed: 当前模型 GCS 变量和 SOFA 神经分组件
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 如果只有总分，仍可用于主模型；SOFA 分组件会受限

source_system: ICU 护理/入院评估/营养系统
time_window_to_extract: ICU 入科前24小时到入科后12小时；若无则取最接近 ICU 入科体重
why_needed: 升压药剂量按体重换算 NEE，尿量也可按 kg 标化
derived_mimic_features_later: NEE dose conversion support, urine ml/kg/h
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 如果缺失体重，NEE 换算需依赖药物记录中已按 kg 标化的剂量

must_have_fields: patient_id, encounter_id, exam_time, report_time, report_text或结构化LVEF
strongly_recommended_fields: lvef_percent, rv_function, valve_abnormality, pasp, diastolic_function, report_conclusion
time_window_to_extract: ICU 入科前30天到 ICU 入科后12小时；优先 landmark12 前最近一次
why_needed: 下一阶段最重要的心衰特异性高价值变量；当前 MIMIC 结构化库缺报告文本
derived_mimic_features_later: LVEF, reduced EF flags, RV dysfunction, pulmonary hypertension, valve disease
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 没有结构化字段时，导出报告全文；后续做文本抽取和人工抽样验证

source_system: 手术麻醉/操作/病案首页 procedure 表
one_row_represents: 一次手术、介入或重要操作
time_window_to_extract: ICU 入科前24小时到入科后60小时
why_needed: 解释突然恶化、亚组分析和潜在混杂
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 若无时间，至少导出住院期间操作名称用于审计

must_have_fields: patient_id, encounter_id, discharge_time, discharge_status, death_flag, death_time
time_window_to_extract: index 住院全程，特别是 ICU 入科后12-60小时
why_needed: 主结局死亡组件和竞争风险/标签审计
minimum_acceptable_fallback: 若死亡时间只有日期，需要标记时间精度；会影响 12-60h 标签
